author: NUS IR

sections.description:
NUS Notify for LINE is an independent plugin and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially provided by LINE or LY Corporation.

Current Integration

  • Contact Form 7
  • Line Business ID, Line application

Contact Form 7 delivery modes

  • Email + LINE: Contact Form 7 sends its configured email and NUS Notify for LINE sends the submitted form data to LINE.
  • LINE Only with Email Fallback: The plugin sends the LINE notification first. Contact Form 7 email is skipped only after LINE confirms successful delivery. If LINE fails because of an invalid access token, invalid target ID, timeout, connection error, or API error, Contact Form 7 sends its configured email as a fallback. Do not enable the Contact Form 7 skip_mail: on setting with this mode because it would also disable the fallback email.

Current features

  • LINE Messaging API Channel Access Token configuration
  • Test LINE notification
  • Contact Form 7 integration
  • Email + LINE delivery mode
  • LINE-only delivery mode with email fallback
  • Email-only delivery mode
  • Contact Form 7 mail is skipped only after successful LINE delivery
  • Contact Form 7 field formatting
  • Internal Contact Form 7 fields excluded from notifications
  • Translation-ready
  • Logging support

Roadmap

  • One basic attachment planned

  • Working with Contact Form 7 Anti-spam integration

    Universal LINE notification plugin for WordPress using LINE Messaging API.

Security Policy

  • Do not publish security issues publicly before contacting us.
  • Do not send any tokens or id to us and on Test mode.
  • Do not provide question fill to ask user to send sensitive data on your forms.

Privacy Policy

  • The plugin sends configured WordPress event data to the LINE Messaging API.
  • Site administrators are responsible for informing users about data processing and obtaining consent when required.
  • Do not send passwords, payment card details, authentication tokens, or other highly sensitive information through form notifications.
  • Do not send sensitive data while using Test mode.
  • We will not responsible for any problem regarding to illegal plugin using, plugin abuse, modified plugin for own sake using, modified plugin for re-new etc.
  • This software is provided without warranty. Site administrators are responsible for lawful configuration, user consent, and the data transmitted through external services.

  • This plugin includes a license file under the GPL-3.0 License – see the LICENSE file for details. Please review LICENSE before using this software.

‘Learning by Building’ – Copyright (C) 2026 IR-Inegration at https://ir9.netlify.app

External Services

This plugin connects to the LINE Messaging API, an external service provided by LY Corporation, to send Contact Form 7 submission notifications to a LINE user, group, or room configured by the website administrator.

The plugin sends data to the LINE Messaging API only when the website administrator sends a connection test, or when Contact Form 7 integration is enabled and an eligible form is submitted.

Depending on the plugin settings and form configuration, the transmitted data may include:
* The configured LINE target ID.
* The notification title.
* The Contact Form 7 form ID and form title.
* Form field values permitted by the website administrator.
* The LINE Channel Access Token, which is transmitted in the HTTPS Authorization header to authenticate the API request.

The plugin attempts to exclude passwords, authentication tokens, API keys, payment-card details, OTP values, and similarly sensitive fields. Website administrators remain responsible for selecting appropriate fields, informing form users, and obtaining any consent required under applicable privacy laws.

No Contact Form 7 submission data is sent to LINE when the integration is disabled or when the delivery mode is set to Email Only.

The LINE Messaging API is provided by LY Corporation:
* LINE Developers Agreement: https://terms.line.me/LINE_Developers_Agreement?lang=en
* LINE Developers Terms and Policies: https://developers.line.biz/en/terms-and-policies/
* LY Corporation Privacy Policy: https://www.lycorp.co.jp/en/company/privacypolicy/

sections.installation:
NUS Notify for LINE’s Documentation by NUS|IR-Inegration

Version: 1.0.1
Updated Date: 07/16/2026

Plugin Description:
Universal LINE notification plugin for WordPress.
Send WordPress notifications to LINE using the official LINE Messaging API.

  1. The main plugin page is located at wp-admin’s Settings.

  2. LINE Channel Access Token:
    To get your Token – Please have your Line’s developer account at https://developers.line.biz/
    You will find it in your administrator account on Line Developer page, under messaging API tab. Please note that, you may have to change the new Token when you reissue your new Token, and before having your Line Developer account, Line will ask you to register the Line Business ID and that’s “your main Line account messenger holder and sender”

  3. LINE Target ID:
    For your Line Developer Account: you’ll find USER ID at the bottom of Basic Settings tab.

For your own personal Line Account:
– Please following this method:
— Go to https://webhook.site/
— Copy your UNIQUE URL on webhook.site to fill in Webhook URL under Messaging API on Line Developer’s page
— And enable using webhook

— //*For User ID:
Let’s any Line user add your Line Official account, and submit any message back to your Line official account

On webhook.site, you’ll find the event logs following on timestamp, at the record, at Request Content > Raw Content, “userId”: “U123xxxxxxxxxxxxx”, this is the target id

— //*For Group ID:
Create Line group on your Line application, invite your own account to join group with your Line official account (Please note that, Line official account has to be allowed to join group, under Line Business ID’s setting, on Account Setting > Group and multi-person chats: Allow account to join groups and multi-person chats, and Allow media file in chat)

In your group chat, just let anyone send any message in the group, the webhook.site will record and show the – groupId”: “Cxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx” on Raw Content

  1. To test your plugin with API:
    — Send Test Message button on plugin’s setting page

  2. Contact Form 7 Integration:
    — Enable the notification to use your Line notify via Contact Form 7
    — Delivery mode is useful when you would not like to receive any email from contact form, and no using SMTP email
    — Allowed Form IDs – You’ll find the id on finished contact form created link, e.g. your-domain.com/wp-admin/admin.php?page=wpcf7&post=1&active-tab=form-panel, ‘1’ is the Form ID
    — Allowed Form Fields – global code recommendation only, important messages you allow to receive

Remarks:
— USER ID target is necessary
— Some issue may occur regarding to some integrated plugin, please read the error on your log file
— Remove the saved LINE token is for changing the new token one
— Enable the webhook URL on Line Developer Console has no effect to this plugin until you remove the token out
— To work with Anti-spam is not compatible right now, please be patient until next release!
— For more information, please read the Release Note or Readme file

To deactivate or to delete the plugin:
— To deactivate is for disable the plugin only, all plugin’s setting are not changed
— To delete all data, please remove the token on your setting’s page, and disable all integration
— Delete the plugin, token, and user target id has no affect to any other plugins and forms
— Uninstall plugin at once is upcoming

*This plugin includes a license file under the GPL-3.0 License – see the LICENSE file for details. Please review LICENSE before using this software.

‘Learning by Building’ – Copyright (C) 2026 IR-Inegration at https://ir9.netlify.app
